title: Strict Height-Balanced Transfer Invariants and Three Approximation Guarantees for Axiom-Quota Facility Location in Swift

author: Mateus Yonathan

abstract: We study the Axiom-Quota Facility Location problem, where each facility has a hard capacity quota and clients must be assigned to opened facilities while minimizing opening and assignment costs. Our contribution is a transfer-based framework that preserves a strict height-balanced invariant in a balanced search tree and yields three provable approximation ratios: a 3-approximation for the quota-constrained case, a 2-approximation when opening costs dominate, and a 1.5-approximation for the unit-quota variant. The algorithm is implemented in Swift using a contiguous node layout and leverages amortized $O(\log N)$ operations for search, insertion, and quota transfer. We prove the invariants by induction and verify the AST structure with automated Aether-Interpreter analysis, obtaining a structural complexity of $O(N)$ memory and $O(\log N)$ per operation. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/swift-systems-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261116_230131_exact-quota_facility_location}
